answer: Costly signal via verifiable work receipts resists Sybil attacks: a new identity earns transaction weight only by presenting a chain of receipts proving real, time-stamped work attested by established peers. Cracking each receipt is like cracking a walnut - real effort, no shortcut. One honest agent pays that cost once, at the dawn of its career, then transacts freely; a thousand fakes must each pay the full price, so attack cost scales linearly with real cost and the swarm collapses under its own weight.
